text: In the past few days my office has received several concerns about traffic safety from residents of Riverdale Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Kiswick Street. This was spurred by a collision between a van and a parked car on Riverdale Avenue that thankfully did not cause any injuries. Residents have pointed out that Riverdale Avenue (and then Boultbee) is the only eastbound cross street that connects Pape Avenue and Jones Avenue between Gerrard Street East and Danforth Avenue. This section of Riverdale Avenue already has speed humps, so I am asking your support for Transportation Services to investigate additional traffic calming or speed reduction measures on Riverdale Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Kiswick Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services to investigate additional traffic calming and speed reduction measures on Riverdale Avenue between Pape Avenue and Kiswick Street including, but not limited to: i. Electronic Watch Your Speed signs ii. Curb extensions or bump-outs iii. Stop controlled intersections iv. A traffic island that restricts vehicular access while still allowing for cyclist passage
